name: DKAN extra fields
description: Surfaces DKAN JSON Schema property values as extra (pseudo) fields in the Drupal field-display UI.
project_description: The DKAN extra fields module exposes the individual JSON Schema property values of DKAN dataset metadata as extra (pseudo) fields in the Drupal field-display UI. DKAN stores dataset metadata as JSON validated against a schema; those properties are not normally individual Drupal fields, so they cannot be placed, ordered, hidden or themed on the node display. This module registers an extra field per schema property (via hook_entity_extra_field_info) on the DKAN 'data' node bundle and renders each one on node view (hook_node_view), including enum values and multi-property list items. It ships three theme hooks (dkan_extra_field, dkan_extra_field_enum, dkan_extra_field_item) with generated per-property, per-data-type and per-view-mode theme suggestions, and a bundled patch (4310-plus.patch) that must be applied to DKAN. It is display-only: no routes, permissions or writes. Maintained by Stefan Korn.
